description: Cognizant is one of the world's leading professional services companies, engineering modern businesses and delivering strategic outcomes for its clients. It helps clients modernize technology, reimagine processes and transform experiences so they can stay ahead in a fast-changing world where artificial intelligence is reshaping organizations in every field, and as an AI builder it provides deep expertise at the intersection of industry and technology, combining its perspective with extensive knowledge of its clients' organizations to build industry-specific platforms and incorporate context into systems, AI models and custom solutions. It tailors its services and solutions to specific industries with an integrated global delivery model that employs client service and delivery teams based at client locations and dedicated global and regional delivery centers, and its services include consulting, application development, systems integration, quality engineering and assurance, application maintenance, infrastructure and security, and business process services and automation.
